'''Beam Island''' is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago.

Location

Beam Island is located to the west of Hatace Island, the east of Middle Island, the south of Peanut Island and the north of Sanfo Island and Watloop Island.

Transport

Points of Interest

Roads

The San-Beam Bridge provides land transport to and from Sanfo Island and enables residents on Beam Island to connect to Route 5 from there. Moreover, the bridge connecting to Peanut Island is currently under construction. Once that bridge is complete, it would connect to San-Beam Bridge.

Park

To the east of Beam Island is Beam Island Park, which has not undegone any development since this island began development. The park features a lake, a gazebo and a jogging trail.

Shopping Mall

A shopping mall is built at the reclamation grounds to the south. It features 50 shops and an outdoors coffee shop.

Power Plant

Beam Island's power plant is located at the east coast of Beam Island, on the opposite side of Beam Island Park. It features three sets of wind power generators and a set of solar panels.
